title: Two officers cleared in shooting death
article: The Special Investigations Unit has cleared two South Simcoe officers of any criminal wrongdoing in the death of Mark Graham, 38, shot July 29 in Bradford.
The officers followed Mr. Graham, a suspect in a shooting earlier that day, to a coffee shop parking lot, where he pulled out a sawed-off rifle and aimed it at them.
The officers responded, fatally shooting him.
